title: Built Different
about: A track about structured thinking, system design, and building things that actually last.
description: Built Different focuses on a systems-based mindset where everything is intentional, modular, and designed for long-term stability. It highlights the balance between structure and adaptability—building with precision, but never forcing something that no longer works. Instead of following existing systems, the track reflects creating, refining, and redesigning them when needed.
lyrics: Verse 1 (Builder)
I don’t build fast, I build it precise
Every layer intentional, every move analyzed
Foundations matter more than the speed of the start
If it can’t hold weight, then it falls apart
I think in patterns, connections, flow
Every piece got a place, every path I know
Not chasing quick wins, I’m shaping design
Something that lasts past a moment in time
I’d rather take time than rebuild twice
Measure the system, then optimize
Clean structure, no wasted space
Built to evolve, not just take up place
Verse 2 (Adaptation)
But I don’t lock in just to say it’s done
If it stops making sense, then I change the run
No pride in a system that clearly breaks
I’d rather rebuild than live with mistakes
I don’t force order when it won’t align
I step back, rework, redefine
Same end goal, different route
Clarity in what it’s really about
Pressure just shows where the weak points hide
I trace it back, then modify
If it cracks at the core, I don’t disguise
I tear it down and redesign
Chorus (Identity)
I don’t follow systems — I make them work
If it don’t fit right, then I shift the structure
Half control, half let it breathe
Built with logic, but I move with ease
I don’t need rules that don’t hold weight
I build what works, I iterate
Not stuck in lines that someone drew
I make the system adjust to me
Bridge (Philosophy)
Rigid minds break, flexible ones adapt
Truth isn’t fixed, it’s deeper than that
I don’t take form just ‘cause it exists
If it don’t make sense, it don’t persist
